summary: Frontend mobile smoke test: dashboard loads and Add navigation works, but tapping Save with an empty amount navigates to Transactions instead of showing form-error, blocking valid save and all dependent flows.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking save with a blank amount leaves the form and opens Transactions; testID form-error is not rendered.

integration_issues.issue: Because the blank-save action navigates away, valid save, local persistence, history rendering, edit, delete, summaries, and filters could not be completed in this run.

action_items: Investigate why the save-expense Pressable click triggers the History navigation on web/mobile layout; blank amount must remain on Add screen and display form-error.
Retest valid save, persistence, edit/delete confirmation, filtering, and chart updates after validation navigation is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: The source saveExpense implementation returns setError for invalid amount and does not navigate, so the observed navigation likely comes from a web Pressable hit-target/layout interaction or event bubbling; inspect rendered DOM/event target around save-expense and bottom nav.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 375x667 viewport, fresh localStorage, dashboard and add-first-expense navigation passed. Clicking [data-testid=save-expense] while amount empty consistently landed on Transactions with no [data-testid=form-error]. No APIs mocked.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: clear localStorage, reload dashboard, tap add-first-expense, scroll save-expense into view, tap it with blank amount. Expected inline validation; observed tab changes to Transactions and amount input disappears. The handler source appears logically correct, so event bubbling/overlapping bottom navigation or React Native web hit testing is the leading hypothesis.
